name: OpenClawBrain
description: Local, profile-bound, conservative intervention layer with redacted proof events.

mode.label: Runtime Mode
mode.help: Conservative stays silent unless the selected evidence policy says a bounded correction/context intervention is useful.

openclawProfile.label: OpenClaw Profile
openclawProfile.help: Config/profile scope used with agent id and session key hash in proof events.

proofEvents.label: Proof Events
proofEvents.help: Write redacted local proof events for status/proof commands.

scopes.agents.label: Scoped Agents
scopes.agents.help: Agent/profile ids this plugin may affect. Empty means all agents in this OpenClaw profile.

scopes.sessionKeys.label: Scoped Session Keys
scopes.sessionKeys.help: Optional exact session keys to allow; proof stores only hashes.
